# möbius for macOS 0.3.4

- Connecting to a möbius Cloud gateway that is still starting now waits and retries instead of failing pairing, with a calm "Your gateway is starting" notice.
- Motion is smoother and consistent: the gateway status fades between its dot and spinner, pages rise into place when you switch sections, chats settle into the list, and new transcript rows rise as they appear. Reduce Motion keeps everything still.
- Interface fonts: choose Geist, IBM Plex, Roboto or Space Grotesk in Appearance.
- The more menu uses the same ellipsis as the rest of the icon set, alongside settings, Cloud and terminal refinements.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.2 (protocol 87).
